packageRules.description: Group the dagger.json engineVersion and the dagger-for-github `version:` inputs into one PR — they're meant to move together.
Group the Dagger pipeline's own base images.

.dagger/go.mod's dependencies are dictated by the Dagger Go SDK's codegen for the engineVersion pinned in .dagger/dagger.json, and only meant to move via `dagger develop -m .dagger` — not independently. Renovate also can't compute go.sum here anyway: `go get -t ./...` fails because it imports the generated, gitignored `internal/dagger` package that only exists after `dagger develop` runs locally (confirmed by a real 'Artifact update problem' on this module before this rule was added).

customManagers.description: Dagger CLI version passed to dagger-for-github. Grouped with .dagger/dagger.json's engineVersion by the dagger/dagger packageRule above, so both sides move in one PR; every workflow that passes `version:` has to be listed here or it is left behind on a bump.
Docker images pinned (tag + digest) as Go string constants in .dagger/main.go, flagged with a `// renovate: datasource=docker` comment
golangci-lint version installed via `go install` in .dagger/main.go
govulncheck version installed via `go install` in .dagger/main.go
yamllint version installed via pip in .dagger/main.go
